summary_1line: Krishna’s plea for peace is followed by a tale of the proud king Dambhodbhava humbled by the sages Nara and Narayana, warning Duryodhana against arrogance and war.
themes: divine identity of Krishna and Arjuna

image_candidates.scene_text: The ascetic Nara stands calmly in the mountains of Gandhamadana, hurling blades of grass that become weapons against the charging army of King Dambhodbhava.
The proud king Dambhodbhava kneels at the feet of the emaciated sages Nara and Narayana after his army is defeated by their miraculous power.
In the Kuru court, the assembled kings sit silent with hair standing on end after Krishna’s speech while Rama begins recounting the ancient story.
